reviewItem.question: Does "MTU auto-detection is now continuous during agent lifetime, changing device MTU no longer requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cilium|name=mtu-auto-detection (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Cilium agent MTU auto-detection is now continuous during the agent lifetime, so changing a device MTU no longer requires an agent restart to be picked up.
